notes: Used robots.txt to discover sitemap index at /rss/index_historico.xml which lists per‑day edition sitemaps (/rss/index_historico_edicion/<id>.xml). Fetched each edition sitemap with the project's polite_fetch helper, parsed <loc> and <lastmod> entries, filtered dates between 2026‑09‑25 and 2026‑10‑25, deduped URLs and wrote them to data/urls_custom/lagaceta-com-ar.tsv. All fetches returned HTTP 200; the sitemap route is allowed by robots.txt and provides reliable publication dates via <lastmod>. Fallbacks (archive pages, Wayback) were not needed. Script prints per‑day URL counts and total (3948 unique URLs).
